notes: After answering a pop-up (like "Save the plan anyway?" or "Delete this planting?"), the app no longer sometimes jumps back to the page you were on — e.g. back to the planting form after the planting had already been saved, where saving again would make a second one.
Arranging plants by hand works again in beds with a net or other cover over them: taps go through the cover to the plants, and a tap close to a plant counts.

Products & seeds (Tools, the 📦 tile) has a tab for each kind of product, and a Seeds & plants tab for your varieties — each with its seed packet photos, used again whenever you plant that variety. Adding a variety of a crop the app doesn't know adds the crop too.
Watering jobs for everything you grow: each bed in the ground (watered much less often than pots — the soil holds far more), indoor pots and seedlings, as well as pots & bags.
Watering follows the latest forecast: it's fetched again whenever you open the app or come back to it, so a forecast that changes (say, rain that's no longer coming) changes the jobs too.

Care jobs follow growth, not the calendar: a cold spell pushes them back, and supports (nets, trellises, stakes) for crops that go through winter — like autumn-sown peas — go up in spring when they start climbing.
Seedlings: "Buy them" or "Sow from seed"; a planting that uses seedlings you started shows them instead.
Thinning advice is in English, and pre-filled for you to change.
The spray days page warns about bee-harmful ingredients in any product (neonicotinoids, pyrethroids, organophosphates and more), and lists which of your sprays have them.
Drop-down lists stay with their field when a pop-up scrolls.
Drop-down lists open right under the field again (crops, products and so on), instead of the phone's own picker or the bar above the keyboard.
Deleting something asks "are you sure?" again.
Both had stopped working in 1.26.0.

If your garden ever can't be loaded, a Recovery screen helps instead: keep a copy of what's stored, go back to one of this phone's daily copies, restore a backup file, or start again — nothing is saved over your garden while it can't be loaded.
Restoring a backup (file, daily copy or Google Drive) can be undone from Tools → Backup, and your photos are no longer cleared before a restore.
Backups made by older versions of the app are tested with every change, so they keep restoring correctly.
The app tells you when a newer version is out, with what's new, and shows what changed after it updates.
There's now a separate test site for trying out changes first, with its own data.
Very large beds no longer freeze the app; bed and pot sizes are checked as you type.
The garden map can zoom in when a big bed makes everything else tiny.
The ruler along beds no longer shows 0, never crowds, and round pots have none.
Behind the scenes: the app's code was reorganised so it's easier to keep working well. Nothing should look different.
